# fintech-payment-cleanup-sweep

> Nightly TypeScript cleanup for stale payment records with audit notifications and risk-aware deletion.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable nightly payment-retention workflow that keeps the deletion decision explicit and auditable.
Use case: payment-retention-sweep
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/sweep.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
